events.title: Demo 20261021-2: Small fixes
events.summary: This note covers our two recent small updates: Fixed the Windows first-launch language picker only appearing after moving the mouse. Improved Windows startup and shutdown speed and corrected the taskbar icon. Limited character resizing to prevent excessively large or small sizes. Fixed Settings display, pet right-click resizing, and house tutorial issues. Adjusted dialogue and Nuwa entrance music volume and completed missing translations. Thanks for your feedback!

events.title: Demo 20261021: Meet your first Tuanbot with Huahua!
events.summary: Hello! The new Tuanbot Demo is live. Join Huahua to plant a tree, discover the main menu and meet Nuwa, who will help you create your first Tuanbot. Give it a name and visit its new home! New interactive onboarding: meet your desktop companions and discover features through short conversations and interactions. Create your own companions: there is no pre-made starter Tuanbot. All 3 Demo creation slots are yours to use. More desktop controls: right-click to resize Tuanbots and NPCs. Huahua, Nuwa,

events.title: The new TuanBot demo is here! Meet your little desktop companions
events.summary: Hi everyone! I’m Hou Xiaohou, the solo developer of TuanBot. What if a few little companions lived their own lives inside your computer? While you’re busy, they wander around your desktop, head back to Tuantuan House to rest, and share little stories with each other. When you take a break, you can see what they’re up to—or ask Feihuahua, the talkative flower, to gather everyone together. That’s the world I’m building with TuanBot.
